role: development-only fair comparison on the existing frozen repeat matrix
shared_features: fold-local word TF-IDF (1,2) plus character TF-IDF (3,5)
shared_outer_cv: KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=20260831) over unique tasks

targets.pairwise_preference: for every model pair, fraction of aligned repeats won plus half credit for ties
targets.performance_prediction: three-repeat mean quality for every model

primary_selection_objective: quality only; cost and latency excluded to isolate learning paradigm
bootstrap_unit: task with model and repeat outcomes paired
selection_rule: select the model with highest predicted class probability, reconstructed pairwise score, or predicted quality
decision_rule: report comparison without post-result tuning; multi-objective deployment remains a separate layer
next_action_if_no_method_passes: do not add Router capacity or DAG; acquire new capability-contrast development tasks and reserve a new untouched holdout
